madhi.does: turns a task into a brief: purpose, audience, tone, outline, research questions

oli.does: researches the brief's questions on the web and returns sourced notes
oli.if_unavailable: skip research and mark the document unresearched

thooya.does: writes the first draft from the brief and the research notes
thooya.rule: output never ships without the scripted checks and Kural's review

kural.does: reviews the draft against the brief; returns small edits or approves
